about:
Welcome to my page! My name is Mihika Jain, and I am a Machine Learning Engineer at Summus where I build AI systems for healthcare. 

 I earned my Master of Engineering in Computer Science from Cornell Tech, where I specialized in machine learning and data science, and my Bachelor of Science in Computer Science with a minor in Business from Cornell University. 

 I am incredibly passionate about machine learning and AI systems, especially when they are applied to complex, domain-specific problems like healthcare, where thoughtful engineering can have a real impact on people's lives. I thrive in collaborative environments and find my greatest strengths in leadership, creativity, and resilience. Outside of computer science, I am passionate about music, snowboarding, sailing, and being outdoors!
